TripItinerary.title: TripItinerary
TripItinerary.description: A user-created Uganda safari and destination itinerary with ordered attraction stops.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the itinerary creator.

title.description: Human-readable name of the Uganda trip itinerary.

stopIds.description: Ordered list of attraction IDs included in the trip (max 25 stops).

totalDistanceKm.description: Estimated road route distance in kilometers.

notes.description: User travel notes and permit reminders.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the itinerary was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the itinerary was last updated.

UserBookmark.title: UserBookmark
UserBookmark.description: A user's saved bookmark or travel log entry for a specific Ugandan attraction.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the bookmark owner.

attractionId.description: ID of the bookmarked Uganda attraction.

personalNote.description: Personal reminder or wildlife sighting note.

visited.description: Whether the user has visited this destination.

/itineraries/{itineraryId}.description: Stores user-created Uganda trip itineraries isolated by ownerId.

/bookmarks/{bookmarkId}.description: Stores user-saved attraction bookmarks and sighting notes isolated by ownerId.
